meta.name: Under Siege
meta.description: Caught in the crossfire, hostages, militaries and guerrillas are swept into a tragedy that brings turmoil to Colombia.

videos.title: Destined for Chaos
videos.overview: In November 1985, a couple arrives at Colombia's Palace of Justice for a date. As tensions mount between the government and the M-19, a plan is formed.

videos.title: No Negotiation
videos.overview: Within the palace, rebels hold hostages at gunpoint. Outside it, the military counterattack as countless families desperately await news.

videos.title: Ceasefire
videos.overview: The guerrilla group's radio fail as their ceasefire demands fall on deaf ears. A week after the siege, journalist Olga Behar meets a surviving guerrilla fighter.

videos.title: Condemned
videos.overview: Three months after the siege, Pilar and Umaña work together to interrogate the military. Olga's investigation puts her at the center of a darker story.

videos.title: Something to Die For
videos.overview: As the military battles the M-19, hostages face more uncertainty. Twelve years later, a gruesome discovery sparks more questions than answers.

videos.title: In Pursuit of the Truth
videos.overview: Twenty years after the siege, a new prosecutor reopens the case. Olga's video evidence is takes, and the military's tactics take a drastic turn.

videos.title: A Reasonable Offer
videos.overview: Ángela interrogates military members. As the crisis within the palace deepens, M-19 and the hostages realise it is too late to surrender.

videos.title: Never Forget
videos.overview: Videos and radio messages become the cornerstone of a trial families have waited years for, as justice is finally set in motion.
